svg.aria-label: The cover of Operating Systems: A Hands-On Approach. Under a starry night sky, a cross-section of a computer system is divided by a glowing gold Trap Gate (SYSCALL / SVC #0) into Ring 3 User Space above and Ring 0 Kernel and Unified Memory Silicon below. In Ring 3, Ferris the Rust crab and Tux the penguin in a hard hat coordinate virtual address spaces, four-level page tables (CR3 to PML4), and a lock-free SPSC ring buffer. In Ring 0 below, Fork the red daemon (PID 1) and a kernel crab supervise a four-core Unified Memory Silicon die, top-half and bottom-half interrupt handlers, pipes, and shared physical frames.

text.font-family: Avenir Next Condensed, Avenir Next, Helvetica Neue, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: FROM SILICON TO SUPERVISORS · C++20 & RUST 2024
